comments.value: Fix the current problems with the player physics and replace them with an explicit ability to climb (see: Climbey, for VR users, the desktop solution must be something else) and a player mod to turn climbing off on a per-world basis.
It's even worse for the HTC vive because we have to repeatedly click the trackpad with our thumb, which is A LOT HARDER AND MORE PAINFUL THAN PRESSING A SPACE BAR... Upvoted....

the climbing isn't even supposed to be a thing to begin with though, it's a physics bug, and you can already make ladders by making a ladder model with a proper full mesh collider and placing it at like a 10 degree angle

(unity's collision detection will trigger step-up on each step and walking into the ladder will put you to the top really fast).

This was fixed a while ago! 🐬

World creators can use the `UseLegacyLocomotion` option to restore the old movement behaviour, but we don't recommend it.

https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/players

Oh, some clarification:

SDK3 allows users to make their own climbing system (ladders!) and it fixes the 'spamming spacebar to climb' bug.

But it *technically* doesn't implement climbing into the SDK.

If a climbing system in SDK3 is still something you'd like to request, please make a new request! Hope that makes sense. ♥

details: How about we add Climbing to the SDK? When Users come to a Ladder, They can climb it.
title: Spamming Spacebar to climb? How about a Ladder?
